title: King Jehoiachin Released from Prison
description: In the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin was taken into exile, Evil-Merodach, the new king of Babylon, showed favor to Jehoiachin and brought him out of prison. He spoke kindly to him and gave him a higher position than the other kings in Babylon. Jehoiachin was allowed to take off his prisoner's clothes, ate regularly at the king's table, and received a daily allowance for all the days of his life.
